sources.quote: Then I revoke Dora's approval for HB-620 today and set Dora to conditional.

findings.why: Fonderia Dora was set to conditional on 2026-09-15. No later document restores it. The 2026-11-06 review restored only Meccanica Chisone. Dora should not receive new business or parts now.

The meeting claim that Dora is still on the approved list relies on APR-009. APR-010 replaced APR-009 and revoked it on 2026-09-15 for HB-620, PLT-PIN and CUST-NOR. No newer approval exists for Dora. The only current HB-620 approval is APR-011 for SUP-H.
